cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until we've weighed both pumpkins. Put yours on the scales first, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is obviously bigger. You win; I need to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Size isn't weight. Take your hand off the pumpkin so we can get a proper reading.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take a photo of yours on the scales. You can send the number later.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait for the display to settle, then photograph it. No, with the pumpkin still in the picture. You can leave as soon as we've both read that number.

reason: Retain B until a stable, jointly seen measurement rather than merely repeating the demand to stay.
